name: Kirisaki Touko
source:
Likes: Fortune telling, chili dogs from MOSDO!, and Labyrinth (Visual Kei Band)
Dislikes: The ocean (nearly drowned as a child), rats
Hobbies: Collecting hair accessories, listening to music

A student from Class 2-4. She loves fortunetelling, a passion she shares with her best friends [url=/c11271]Emi[/url] and [url=/c11335]Mitsuki[/url]. Tohko’s usually lively and cheerful, but occasionally will act nervous. She loathes [url=/c22374]Shimada[/url] for his irresponsible way of dealing with girls, and has a crush on the cool and spotless [url=/c6508]Yuuya[/url].

[From the [url=https://corpseparty.fandom.com/wiki/Touko_Kirisaki]Corpse Party Wiki[/url]]
